_note: Battery spread comes from NASA PCoE lab cells (analogue). Solar and downlink ranges are game assumptions chosen by the team, not measurements.

battery_fade_per_month.source: Spread only (cv = 0.149) from linear capacity-fade fits of NASA PCoE cells B0005, B0006, B0007 and B0018 (4 lab cells, an analogue). The mean of 0.01 per month is a game assumption, not from this data.

solar_scale.source: Game assumption: array output between 85% and 100% of rated, most likely 95%. Not from a measurement.

downlink_scale.source: Game assumption: usable downlink between 50% and 100% of nominal, most likely 80%. Not from a measurement.
